newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany first nation to approve new vaccine.
newsitem.headline: Germany first nation to approve new vaccine.

text.p: Germany became the first nation to approve a new vaccine which can innoculate patients against four illnesses at once, German health authorities said on Monday.

The vaccine, using the active ingredient Infanrix DTP+Hib, is manufactured by U.S-U.K drugs giant SmithKline Beecham Plc and innoculates patients against tetanus, diphtheria, whooping cough and bacterial meningitis.
Previously children needed to be vaccinated twice in order to be protected against these diseases.
When contacted by Reuters, Germany's Federal Authority for Sera and Innoculations confirmed that the vaccine had been approved last week.
